title: How many agency RN shifts a hospital association's winter surge pool should block-book for the four weeks from 4 January 2027, when this winter's respiratory wave peaked in the south in December and the North's hospitals, new to the pool, have always met it five to six weeks after the Southeast
subdomain: patient flow, beds and workforce optimization (a hospital association's winter agency nurse pool: the January block forecast region by region, each region's respiratory surge timed by its lag behind the region it spreads from, read off the closed winters' capacity census)
prompt_shape: a committed block of agency RN shifts for four weeks, each of last winter's 16 pool hospitals' funded shifts and shifts billed to the pool that it did not fund, and a weekly chart of the funded shifts by agency
